Definition: Succoth, the name of a place in Egypt and of three in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Succoth is the name of places in Egypt and in the land, and Jacob names the first one for the booths he builds there. Israel journeys from Rameses to Succoth on the night of the Exodus, and the name marks the first stage of the journey out. The place is named for shelter, and the shelter is the first thing a freed people needs.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Succoth matters because the Exodus begins with a place to rest, and God gives His people shelter on the first night of freedom.
